title: 2317. Maximum XOR After Operations

examples.explanation: Apply the operation with x = 4 and i = 3, num[3] = 6 AND (6 XOR 4) = 6 AND 2 = 2. Now, nums = [3, 2, 4, 2] and the bitwise XOR of all the elements = 3 XOR 2 XOR 4 XOR 2 = 7. It can be shown that 7 is the maximum possible bitwise XOR. Note that other operations may be used to achieve a bitwise XOR of 7.
Apply the operation zero times. The bitwise XOR of all the elements = 1 XOR 2 XOR 3 XOR 9 XOR 2 = 11. It can be shown that 11 is the maximum possible bitwise XOR.
